description: Cancel a queued or scheduled task. Idempotent — if the task is already completed/failed/cancelled this returns the existing status without error. Throws only if task_id is unknown. Cancelling one occurrence of a repeating task skips it and queues the next one; pass series=true to end the series.

series.description: If true and the task repeats, also end its series: no further occurrence is queued. Default false (skip only this occurrence).

task_id.description: The id of the task to cancel.

name: cancel_task
